description:
T1, Yew (approx 6m) with over extended branches reaching into garden of property and neighbours. Proposing to remove dead branches and crown reduction by 1m back to suitable growth points in accordance with BS3998 to abate a nuisance to neighbouring properties.
T2, Bay Laurel (approx 6m) with unattractive shape and restricting light into gardens on Eastern boundary. Proposing to reduce height by 2m back to suitable growth points in accordance with BS3998 and shape to enable future maintenance.
T3, Acer (approx 3m) with over extended branches reaching into neighbouring garden. Proposing to reduce over extended branches back to suitable growth points in accordance with BS3998 and shape aesthetically.
T4, Magnolia (approx 1.5m) with over extended branches reaching over footpath to front door and onto front lawn. Proposing to prune into shape to suitable growth points in accordance with BS3998.
